packageRules.description: Auto-merge non-major updates. They land on main and reach consumers only when a release moves the v1 alias, so a bad bump is caught before anyone takes it.
Our own refs (@v1) are the line alias, moved by cutting a release, never by a bump.
changesets/action's major is paired with consumers' @changesets/cli major. Moving it is a breaking release (v2 of this repo), not a dependency bump.
